newsitem.title: UK: Shield up amid talk of investor briefing.
newsitem.headline: Shield up amid talk of investor briefing.

text.p: Shares in Shield Diagnostics Plc rose on Tuesday, bouncing from yesterday's decline as a report in the Independent newspaper said the company's broker UBS was hosting institutional briefings with the drug company this week.
The stock was up 27-1/2p at 635 by 0816 GMT, after on Monday falling 30p.
No-one at the company was initially available for comment.
On Monday Shield said in a statement it believes its test for Active Factor Twelve (AFT) could be a major contibutor to the early identification of those at risk from cardiovascular disease.
Shield shares have rocketed since the end of January when they were trading at below 150p.
